messages:
anya: thinking about running a small quota-lift experiment on the embeddings ingress soft-cap — 5% tenants for 48h. goal: measure routing impact + console UX when softcap is temporarily raised. any blockers?

jordan: curious what signals we want to capture besides success rate and latency. maybe unit_estimate_error and preflight_accept_rate?

eli: agree. also capture split_count distribution (how often splitter triggers) and route_fallback_rate. want to know if we push more bytes->more splits->more backend load.

morgan: my only concern is billing noise. if we lift softcap we need to tag those tenant requests in billing pipeline so cost analysis is isolated. add header like `X-Experiment: embed-softcap-lift-v1`.

anya: yes — plan to inject `X-RL-Exp: embed-softcap-lift-v1` and a console badge on tenant pages. console badge should show "Softcap lifted — experimental" with link to experiment dashboard.

katie: can we also expose a tiny toggle in the console for on/off per-tenant? ops might need to yank early. toggle should map to `/api/admin/experiments/{tenant}/toggle`.

eli: for telemetry, propose these metrics: `embed.preflight.accept_rate`, `embed.estimate.error_pct`, `embed.split.count.p50/p95`, `embed.route.fallback_rate`, `embed.ingress.bytes.p95`, and a tag `exp=embed-softcap-lift-v1`.

jordan: + logs: sampler should add `exp_id` and `preflight_units` to the request log so we can reconcile with billing. also trace parent id to route decisions so we can measure extra hops.

morgan: technical nit — if we change softcap at ingress, splitter logic has a threshold based on bytes+dim heuristic. need to ensure the runtime kernel selection doesn't bias results. maybe run a canary that only toggles quota layer (not splitter) first.

anya: good call. plan: step1 rollout = only bypass quota check at gateway (no splitter changes). step2 = enable larger per-request unit allowance and observe split delta. step3 = compare quality and cost.

deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled: embed-gateway-canary v2026.03.22-qs1 -> 2026-03-22T14:00Z (5% tenants).

eli: about console UX: on the embeddings route details page add a small chart for `preflight_accept_rate` over time and a histogram for `estimate.error_pct`. also surface a tooltip: "High estimate error => requests may be split unexpectedly."

katie: ops runbook in case of overload: 1) toggle off experiment per-tenant, 2) enable route fallback to smaller model variant, 3) roll forward gateway revert. we should publish that as a tiny doc link from the console badge.

jordan: does the quota dashboard need a new column for `experiment_tag`? otherwise queries will mix baseline + experiment.

anya: yep we'll add an experiment filter in the dashboard and a rollout flag in the UI. analytics will be a separate table so we don't skew production quotas.

eli: last thing — sampling: increase distributed tracing sampling for experimented tenants to 10% (from 1%) while active so we have enough traces for route decision analysis.

morgan: shared JSON snippet for the header + toggles we can use in SDKs:

```
// client-side hint
headers: {
  "Authorization": "Bearer ...",
  "X-RL-Exp": "embed-softcap-lift-v1",
  "X-Client-Hint": "estimate-v=2"
}
```

anya: awesome. I'll kick off the gateway canary and wire up the console badge + dashboard filters. tagging @katie for runbook and @jordan for logging changes. will post results in ~48h. :rocket:
